subject: tr-def
title: TR.DEF.------CULT.SOLD.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-37, where Braxton defines a spectacle-diversion sequence as determined by '(1) the time cycle of a given situation, (2) the vibrational cycle (and how this consideration is manifested in a given physical universe situation), (3) the social reality cycle of a given culture, and finally (4) the political particulars of a given culture.' (C)TR-DEF (trans-definition — Braxton's term for the move to redefine concepts across cultural transfer) is crossed with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification): the question is what trans-definition does to culture solidification when spectacle-diversion is operative. CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) feeds the subject. The crossing produces a fan of outputs through CULT-SOLD: C-CONT (composite continuance), MT-INFO (multi-information), LK-IMP (linkage implications), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), and POST (postulation). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) feeds the lower part of the diagram. Structural argument: trans-definition's path through culture-solidification is over-determined — six parallel outputs constitute the spectacle-cycle's entire cultural footprint. The diagram exposes how 'blending' (Braxton's term for the spectacle blending in with whatever substance is being absorbed) creates an apparatus where culture-solidification absorbs every other dimension.
